errors.text_span: Das Diagramm zeigt die Betroffenheit der Betriebe von der Mindestlohnanhebung auf 12 Euro
errors.evidence: The figure does not mention or depict any information about minimum wage impact; it shows the percentage share of different industries and business sizes among all businesses.
The figure shows the bar for „Nahrungs- und Genussmittel“ closer to 47-48%, not 45%.
The figure shows the bar for „Einzelhandel“ closer to 42-43%, not 40%.
The figure shows the bar for „Verbrauchsgüter“ closer to 37-38%, not 35%.
The figure shows the bar for „Sonstige Dienstleistungen“ closer to 36%, not 33%.

errors.text_span: „Mittlere Betriebe (50-249)“ den höchsten Wert in dieser Gruppe mit circa 38 %
errors.evidence: The figure shows the bar for „Mittlere Betriebe (50-249)“ closer to 39%, not 38%.
The description does not explicitly mention the small gap in the vertical axis between the industry categories and the business size categories.
